senses.definition: vb. weave together (‖ form of II. שָׂכַךְ; NH Hiph. הֵסֵיךְ weave, סוּכָּה, booth);—
Impf. 2 ms. sf. תְּסֻכֵּנִי ψ 139:13 thou didst weave me together. Pô. id. Jb 10:11.
